coverage_summary: Reviewed all 8 trajectories. The encoder and placeholder boundaries are appropriately left unresolved, but documented dataset curation and training-state details are missing or incompletely represented.

findings.detail: The pretraining selection step omits the documented removal of articles without full text and articles with duplicate IDs before the refined corpus is formed.

evidence.quote: After removing articles without full text and those with duplicate IDs, we attain a refined dataset of 4.2 million articles.

findings.required_change: Record these documented filters in the corpus-selection path, with an intermediate state or explicit selection parameters.

findings.detail: The PubChemQA route starts with a 2D molecular graph and omits documented dataset filtering and graph preparation, including RDKit processability filtering and text exclusion/cropping.

evidence.quote: We remove molecules that cannot be processed by RDKit [Landrum et al., 2021] to generate 2D molecular graphs. We also remove texts with less than 4 words, and crops descriptions with more than 256 words.

findings.required_change: Add a source-backed preprocessing boundary before molecule_graph that preserves the RDKit filtering, 2D graph generation, and the paper-defined text curation rules. Do not introduce any additional size rule.

findings.detail: The multimodal alignment trajectory records optimized modality-adaptor parameters but does not preserve the explicitly stated frozen status of BioMedGPT-LM or the corresponding encoder/adaptor optimization context.

evidence.quote: Following mPLUG-owl [Ye et al., 2023], we freeze the parameters of BioMedGPT-LM and optimize the parameters of the molecule encoder, protein encoder, and modality adaptors to save the computational cost and avoid catastrophic forgetting.

findings.required_change: Record BioMedGPT-LM as frozen and the explicitly optimized encoder/adaptor parameters in the trajectory-level training context.

findings.detail: The UniProtQA alignment trajectory likewise omits the documented frozen language-model state and optimization scope.

evidence.quote: Following mPLUG-owl [Ye et al., 2023], we freeze the parameters of BioMedGPT-LM and optimize the parameters of the molecule encoder, protein encoder, and modality adaptors to save the computational cost and avoid catastrophic forgetting.

findings.required_change: Record BioMedGPT-LM as frozen and preserve the stated optimization scope for the protein encoder and modality adaptor.

findings.detail: The ChEBI-20 fine-tuning projection is labeled with the specific state “fine-tuned molecular adaptor,” but the cited task text establishes only BioMedGPT-10B fine-tuning and a frozen language model; it does not explicitly identify the adaptor update state.

evidence.quote: We fine-tune BioMedGPT-10B using the same prompts as Table 1.
The fine-tuning procedure consists of 50 epochs with a learning rate of 7 × 10 -5 and a batch size of 24, and we freeze the parameters of the language model to reduce computation cost.

findings.required_change: Preserve the explicitly frozen language-model state and avoid asserting adaptor-specific fine-tuning unless it is explicitly attributed to this ChEBI-20 route.

findings.detail: The PubChemQA alignment input is represented as generic question text, while the paper documents a single task-specific question.

evidence.quote: It contains a single type of question, i.e., please describe the molecule.

findings.required_change: Annotate the PubChemQA text input with the documented question content while retaining the generic prompt interface if desired.

findings.detail: The UniProtQA alignment route does not preserve the four documented query categories, although the shared prompt path can remain common across them.

evidence.quote: UniProtQA consists of proteins and textual queries about their functions and properties. The dataset is constructed from UniProt [Consortium, 2022], and consists 4 types of questions with regard to functions, official names, protein families, and sub-cellular locations.

findings.required_change: Record the four documented query categories on the protein text-input/task configuration; separate operation branches are unnecessary if their processing is identical.
